name: Wire Office of the First Minister
notes: Stands between the wire and the First Minister (a filter, 0058); empty at the start, as the stand-in comms World had it.

name: Aldmoor Navy Yard
notes: An Admiralty post inside a region whose defences the War Ministry commands.

name: Gull Rock Fort
notes: Besieged; under standing orders not to fire first.

name: Gull Rock relief: troops
notes: A joint expedition is two temporary posts, one per ministry, linked; each dissolves when the operation ends.

name: Westwatch River Flotilla
notes: Built by the War Ministry; passes to the Admiralty on a date.

name: President of the Aldmoor and Brenn Railway
notes: A holder outside the chain of command, reached by requisition.

name: Council Wire Office
notes: The South's filter post; empty at the start.

name: Governor of Lowmarch
notes: Answers the Southern War Office by requisition, not by command.

name: Governor of Brenmark
notes: Answers the First Minister's calls for regiments by his own compliance (lane 1.7).
